incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired — PD-98765 autoscaler: queue_backlog_high
pd-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-98765 triggered for service=inference-autoscaler, severity=critical :rotating_light:
alex_j: Acked on call. I'm looking.
sara_ops: I'm on standby, will help with capacity plan.
mike_infra: Thanks — any obvious errors in node provisioning?
alex_j: Checking logs now, looks like kube-provisioner failing to allocate nodes, qps spike + quota error.
alex_j: paste
```
E0503 12:11:05 kube-provisioner.go:203] failed to create instance: quota exceeded: 'virtualMachines' quota limit reached
```
incident-bot: Autoscaler queue length > 5000 for 6m, avg latency 3.8s, drop_rate 0.7%
jess_plat: Customer-facing metrics show elevated 500s for some tenants, highest for org-42. Can we do temporary routing to spare pool?
sara_ops: We have dedicated spare pool but it's in a different region. Cross-region failover would add latency.
alex_j: Trying manual node spin-up to bypass quota error (using infra-admin project). If that fails we'll attach reserved hosts.
mike_infra: FYI provisioning API returning 429 on create, maybe cloud-side rate limit. I'll escalate to cloud support if needed.
sara_ops: Quick mitigation options: 1) throttle incoming requests at edge 2) divert lower-priority tenants to reduced capacity models 3) enable burst-surge on dedicated pool.
alex_j: Executing 1) temporarily set rate limit for /v1/generate to 20rps per key for new sessions: `kubectl apply -f edge-rate-limit.yaml`.
alex_j: Applied. Pushing config: `kubectl get configmap edge-rate-limit -o yaml` shows new limit.
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  generate_rps: "20"
```
pd-bot: PagerDuty note added by alex_j: 'temp rate limit applied; manual node spin-up in progress'
sara_ops: I'm starting tenant cutoff ramp for non-SLAs: `rbacctl set-traffic org:non-sla --weight 0.2`.
jess_plat: Noted — prod metrics: tail latency dropped to 2.1s after rate limit, queue ingress down 38%.
alex_j: Manual node create still failing with quota. Switching to reserved-host attach: `cloudctl attach-host --pool spare-dedicated --count 10`.
mike_infra: That command returned partial success, 6 hosts attached, 4 failed with 'instance type unavailable'. Scaling boundary still below required.
alex_j: Rolling out model fallback policy for heavy prompt models to m-small until capacity stabilizes.
```
route_rules:
  - match: heavy-prompt
    action: fallback:m-small
```
sara_ops: Good, fallback applied. Monitoring impact.
jess_plat: Customer impact: org-42 saw ~12% error rate at peak, now down to 3%. Support page updated with temporary advisory.
incident-bot: Autoscaler backlog decreased to 800 in last 10m. Continuing to monitor.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: PD-98765 acknowledged by alex_j at 2025-05-03T12:19:11Z

sara_ops: Action items: 1) Request quota increase (mike) 2) Implement pre-warm reserved hosts (infra) 3) Add warmup probe to autoscaler so it doesn't count warm nodes as ready prematurely (platform) 4) Update runbook with cross-region spillover thresholds (ops)
alex_j: Creating follow-up ticket INF-2211 and assigning owners.
jess_plat: I'll draft customer postmortem note with timeline and mitigation steps.
alex_j: Paging rotation handoff: I'm on call for 15 more minutes then handing to sara_ops. Sara, you good to take over?

alex_j: Thanks team. Marking incident as 'mitigated' for now — queue stabilized but root cause still quota. Will keep PD open until quota resolved.
